messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — reserved GPU commit utilization in us-west1 is showing a ~15% gap vs billing. Finance flagged unallocated committed hours. Suspect untagged nodes after the autoscaler rollout last week. Anyone noticed label drift?
Maria Gomez: Yep saw a bunch of nodes come up without `owner`/`cost_center` labels during the canary. Autoscaler fallback to spot nodepool might be skipping our labeling webhook.
Siva Reddy: Can you paste the billing export query you're using to spot untagged GPU hours?
Alex Chen: Pasting what I ran (BigQuery):

```
SELECT
  COALESCE(labels.owner, 'UNLABELED') AS owner,
  resource.region AS region,
  sku.description AS sku,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost,
  SUM(usage_amount) AS gpu_hours
FROM
  `company_billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE
  sku.description LIKE '%GPU%'
  AND usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY owner, region, sku
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC
```

Alex Chen: Results show ~2.2k GPU hours in us-west1 with owner=NULL and project_id=redwood-prod.
Maria Gomez: Same — most unlabeled hours are from the shared-gpu-pool nodepool. When spot fallback occurred, the pool created nodes that didn't go through our init-labeler.
Kate Marshall: Is this affecting Dedicated commitments? We need to attribute these before month-end so commitments map to cost centers. Finance will want retro allocations.
billing-bot: Alert: Reserved-commit-utilization us-west1-gpu-pool dropped below 85% for the last 7 days — ticket created #BILL-4721.
Siva Reddy: Proposed short plan:
1) Backfill labels for the existing nodes (kube API + node metadata).
2) Run retro-chargeback for unlabeled hours using nodepool -> cost_center mapping.
3) Fix autoscaler hooks to always call our init-labeler, add unit test.
4) Add an admission check to reject node creation without required labels.
Maria Gomez: I'm on (1) and (2). I'll write a reconciliation script that joins billing export to cluster node inventory and emits a CSV for finance. ETA EOD.
Alex Chen: Please include region and SKU in the CSV so finance can apply the right commitment SKU mapping. Also include the commit coverage percent per cost center.
Kate Marshall: Also double-check cross-region fallback — we have committed capacity in us-west2 too and some jobs might have run in us-west1 consuming the wrong reservation. Query must include `resource.region` and `sku.description`.
Siva Reddy: Good catch. Add `AND resource.region IS NOT NULL` in the query and group by region.
Maria Gomez: I'll push the updated BigQuery to #billing-queries and open a PR with a small Python backfill that uses the cluster inventory API.
Alex Chen: Action items: Maria -> backfill + CSV + PR; Siva -> admission controller spike + autoscaler hook fix; Kate -> loop in finance on #BILL-4721 and keep them posted on retro allocation numbers. Ping me if you need capacity or credentials. :thumbsup:
Kate Marshall: I'll coordinate with finance and confirm the mapping rules for retro-billing.
Siva Reddy: I'll add a quick alert to our cost dashboards for unlabeled GPU hours so we catch regressions.
Maria Gomez: Starting the query now, will post results shortly.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — let's try to have the backfill and allocation plan ready before the billing close next week.
